location.en: Maple Bay Language Institute, classroom after class
location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，下課後的教室

goal.en: Turn down Zoe's party invitation without hurting her feelings.
goal.zh: 婉拒柔伊的派對邀請，又不讓她難過。

background: empty language school classroom after class with rows of wooden desks, a blank whiteboard, chairs pushed in, a potted plant on the windowsill, warm evening light

intro.en: Thursday afternoon. Your big writing test is tomorrow morning, and you still have two chapters to review.
intro.zh: 星期四下午。明天早上就是重要的寫作考試，你還有兩個章節沒複習。

intro.en: Zoe, the most social person in your class, runs over with her phone in her hand.
intro.zh: 班上最愛交朋友的柔伊拿著手機跑了過來。

lines.en: Kai! I'm having a party at my place tonight. Want to come?
lines.zh: 凱！我今晚在我家辦派對，要不要來？

choices.en: I'd love to, but I have a test tomorrow.
choices.zh: 我很想去，可是我明天有考試。
choices.tip: I'd love to, but... 先表達想去，再說理由，拒絕聽起來就很溫和。

choices.en: No. I must study for my test tonight.
choices.zh: 不要，我今晚一定要讀書準備考試。

story.en: Zoe smiles politely, but she doesn't invite you to anything for the next three weeks.
story.zh: 柔伊客氣地笑了笑，但接下來三個禮拜，她再也沒約過你。

fail.why: 一開口就說 No. 太生硬，聽起來像對邀約本身沒興趣。先說 I'd love to, but...，再說理由，對方比較不會受傷。

choices.en: Sorry, I'm not convenient. I have a test tomorrow.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我不方便，我明天有考試。

lines.en: You're not convenient? Like a store that closes early?
lines.zh: 你不方便？像提早關門的便利商店那樣嗎？

story.en: Zoe laughs and tells the whole class that Kai is "closed tonight." It becomes your nickname for a week.
story.zh: 柔伊笑著跟全班說凱「今晚公休」，這個綽號跟了你一整個禮拜。

fail.why: 「我不方便」直翻成 I'm not convenient. 是中式英文，convenient 用來形容時間或事物，不形容人。要說 It's not a good time for me. 或 I'd love to, but I can't.。

lines.en: Aw, come on! Just come for one hour?
lines.zh: 唉唷，來嘛！來一個小時就好？

choices.en: Sorry, I really can't. I need to study.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我真的沒辦法，我得讀書。
choices.tip: 對方再邀一次時，用 Sorry, I really can't. 溫和但清楚地再拒絕一次。

choices.en: Hmm, maybe. I'll see how I feel later.

lines.en: Maybe? So should I count you in or not?
lines.zh: 再看看？所以我到底要不要把你算進去？

story.en: Zoe counts you in and saves you a slice of pizza. She texts you all night, asking where you are.
story.zh: 柔伊把你算進人數，還幫你留了一片披薩。她整晚一直傳簡訊問你到哪了。

fail.why: 中文的「再看看」常是委婉拒絕，但英文的 maybe 真的代表「有可能」，對方會一直等你。不能去就說清楚：Sorry, I really can't.。

choices.en: Sorry, I can't. I must to study.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我不行，我必須讀書。

lines.en: "Must to"? Wow, Kai, you really DO need to study!
lines.zh: Must to？哇，凱，你真的很需要讀書耶！

story.en: Zoe laughs and agrees you should stay home. Then she sends you a grammar meme every hour all night.
story.zh: 柔伊笑著同意你該留在家讀書，接著整晚每小時傳一張文法梗圖給你。

fail.why: must 是助動詞，後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to：I must study.。口語更常說 I need to study. 或 I have to study.。

lines.en: Okay, okay. Good luck on your test, then!
lines.zh: 好啦好啦，那祝你考試順利！

choices.en: Thanks for asking, though. Maybe next time?
choices.zh: 不過還是謝謝你約我。下次吧？
choices.tip: Thanks for asking. 感謝對方的心意，加上 Maybe next time? 表示你還想被約。

choices.en: I deeply appreciate your kind invitation.
choices.zh: 我深深感謝您親切的邀請。

lines.en: Um... you're welcome? Are you writing me a letter?
lines.zh: 呃……不客氣？你是在寫信給我嗎？

story.en: At the party, Zoe tells everyone that Kai talks like a business email. Now they all want to hear it.
story.zh: 柔伊在派對上跟大家說凱講話像商業書信，現在大家都想親耳聽一次。

fail.why: I deeply appreciate your kind invitation. 文法沒錯，但對同學說太正式，像在寫公文。朋友之間說 Thanks for asking! 就很自然。

choices.en: Thank you invite me. Next time again!
choices.zh: 謝謝你邀請我，下次再約！

lines.en: Next time... again? So is that a yes or a no?
lines.zh: 下次……再？所以你是要來還是不來？

story.en: Zoe nods slowly, not sure what you said. She sends you the address anyway, just in case.
story.zh: 柔伊慢慢點頭，搞不清楚你的意思，還是把地址傳給你以防萬一。

fail.why: 「謝謝你邀請我」要說 Thank you for inviting me.，thank you 後面接 for + V-ing。「下次再約」英文說 Maybe next time.。

lines.en: Next time for sure! Oh, which test is it tomorrow?
lines.zh: 下次一定喔！對了，明天考哪一科？

choices.tip: Wish me luck! 是考試、面試前很常說的一句，輕鬆又自然。

lines.en: I know it's tomorrow. I mean, which subject?
lines.zh: 我知道是明天啦。我是問哪一科？

story.en: You both talk about the time for two more minutes. Zoe leaves still not knowing the subject, so she wishes you luck with "everything."
story.zh: 你們又繞著時間聊了兩分鐘。柔伊離開時還是不知道是哪一科，只好祝你「什麼都順利」。

fail.why: Which test? 問的是哪一科，不是什麼時候，也不能用 Yes 回答。直接說科目：Writing.，再加一句 Wish me luck!。

choices.en: Writing. Please add oil for me!

lines.en: Add oil? To what? Your car?
lines.zh: 加油？加到哪裡？你的車嗎？

story.en: Zoe spends five minutes asking about your car. You don't have a car.
story.zh: 柔伊花了五分鐘問你的車的事，但你根本沒有車。

fail.why: 「加油」直翻成 add oil，對方會以為你在講汽車。要別人幫你打氣說 Wish me luck!，替別人打氣說 Good luck! 或 You can do it!。

lines.en: Good luck, Kai! I'll send you a photo of the cake.
lines.zh: 祝你好運，凱！我會傳蛋糕的照片給你。

lines.en: The next morning, you walk into the test rested and ready.
lines.zh: 隔天早上，你睡飽了，信心滿滿地走進考場。

story.en: You studied, you slept well, and you still have a friend who wants to invite you again.
story.zh: 你讀了書、睡飽了，還保住一個想再約你的朋友。

notes.explain: 婉拒邀約的萬用開頭：先表示想去，再說理由，對方比較不會覺得被拒絕。

example.en: I'd love to, but I have to work on Saturday.
example.zh: 我很想去，可是星期六要上班。

notes.en: Thanks for asking. Maybe next time?
notes.explain: 拒絕後補一句感謝和 Maybe next time?，表示你珍惜對方的心意，也歡迎對方再約。

example.en: Thanks for asking! Maybe next weekend?
example.zh: 謝謝你約我！下週末好嗎？

notes.en: It's not a good time for me.
notes.explain: 「我不方便」不能說 I'm not convenient.，convenient 不用來形容人。可以說 It's not a good time for me. 或 I can't make it.。

example.en: Sorry, tonight is not a good time for me.

notes.explain: 中文的「再看看」常是委婉拒絕，但英文的 maybe 會讓對方真的等你。不能去就說清楚，再溫和地補上理由。

example.en: Sorry, I really can't make it tonight.
example.zh: 抱歉，我今晚真的沒辦法去。

notes.explain: 「加油」不能說 add oil。替自己打氣說 Wish me luck!，替別人打氣說 Good luck! 或 You can do it!。

example.en: I have a job interview today. Wish me luck!
example.zh: 我今天有面試，祝我好運！
